summary: AgSpray Pro frontend-only test: seeded data loads, all 3 calculators produce correct values, weather auto-fetches from Open-Meteo (5 stats populated), Delta T shows disclaimer and NO 'safe to spray' verdict anywhere (Home, Delta T, New Record), tab navigation works, Records/Machinery/Chemicals lists render seeded data, filter chips render, New Spray Record farm→paddock→area auto-populate works, AsyncStorage persists across reloads. 27/28 assertions passed; the single 'fail' was a timing false-negative — the screenshot confirmed area was auto-populated to 42.

issues: Seeded maintenance data does not exercise the 'Due Soon' badge state. Big Rig has 120h remaining vs 25h threshold in maintenanceStatus (storage.ts:147). Only Overdue (Case 340) and Good (Big Rig, Hardi) are visible on Home. Consider adjusting one seeded record so remaining hours <=25 to showcase the Due Soon badge (e.g., set Big Rig last_service_hours=2380 next=2400 or increase current_hours). Not a bug — just missing visual coverage of the 3rd badge state.

action_items: (Optional/nice-to-have) Tune seed data in /app/frontend/src/lib/seed.ts so at least one maintenance item lands in the 'Due Soon' bucket (remaining 0<=x<=25 hours) so the Home page demonstrates all three status badges.
No functional fixes required — all requested flows pass.
critical_code_review_comments: calculators.ts formulas verified against expected values (nozzle=1.2 L/min, nozzles=60, boom=72 L/min, ha/tank=50, chem/tank=75 L).

Delta T disclaimer wording 'Check current product label, weather conditions and local spraying requirements before application.' present on Home weather card, Delta T Calculator, and New Spray Record — legally-required disclaimer coverage is correct.
No 'safe to spray' verdict text appears anywhere in the app (verified on Home, Delta T Calc, New Record) — matches requirement.

Uses TouchableOpacity/Pressable, View/Text/ScrollView, StyleSheet.create — React Native best practices followed. No deprecated Expo packages (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch). expo-location, expo-web-browser, expo-haptics, expo-blur, expo-linear-gradient, expo-image are current.
seed_data_creation: None — seed.ts pre-seeds 1 business, 2 farms, 5 paddocks, 5 chemicals, 3 machines, 3 maintenance records, 2 spray jobs on first load. Verified all seed items render.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully client-side (AsyncStorage). No backend/API to test. To reset seed for retesting, run localStorage.clear() in web preview or clear AsyncStorage. All testIDs are present on interactive elements. Calculators are deterministic and can be unit-tested via /app/frontend/src/lib/calculators.ts.
